entities.summary: Madagascar is a sovereign nation in East Africa, Africa. Its capital is Antananarivo. Official languages include Malagasy, French. Government: Unitary semi-presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 31.4 million. Area: 587,041 km². Comprehensive index for Madagascar covering Austronesian settlement (unique in Africa), Merina kingdom, French colonisation, 1947 uprising, independence, Ratsiraka socialism, political crises, and world-renowned biodiversity including lemurs.
